name: What kind of materials do you use for dry rot repair and replacement?

mainEntity.name: What kind of materials do you use for dry rot repair and replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For dry rot repair and replacement, we prioritize using materials that match or exceed the original structural integrity and aesthetic. This often includes pressure-treated lumber, engineered wood products, or other suitable materials resistant to future decay, ensuring longevity and durability. When the repair is part of a larger customized renovation, such as a kitchen or bathroom remodel, we select replacement materials that seamlessly integrate with the new design, upholding our commitment to craftsmanship. Our focus is on long-term value, enhancing both the structural soundness and the beauty of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use durable, decay-resistant materials like pressure-treated lumber for dry rot repair. When integrated with renovations, materials are chosen to match structural needs and overall design.
